'''KR2-M80''' was an [[astromech droid]] that was [[Slavery|forced to work]] in the control room of the criminal [[Pyke Syndicate]]'s [[spice]] [[Spice mines of Kessel|mines]] on the [[planet]] [[Kessel]]. The [[droid]] featured a [[Color|silver]] dome, and white and yellow plating and it used an [[Intellex IV]] [[droid brain]].<ref name="SoloGuide">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]''</ref> In [[10 BBY]], KR2-M80 was freed when his [[restraining bolt]] was removed during a [[Raid on Kessel|slave revolt]] in the [[Mining|mines]] started by the [[droid]] [[L3-37]]. KR2-M80 stood by one of the room's consoles as the criminals in the control room remotely guided their companion [[Han Solo]] to the mines' [[coaxium]] vault, after which the criminals left the room in order to escape Kessel. KR2-M80 was shortly afterwards standing on one of the landing platforms while around it raged a battle between the freed slaves and their slavers.<ref name="Solo: A Star Wars Story">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
KR2-M80 first appeared in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology]] film, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloGuide" />
